consensus_summary: Nine non-ranking roadmap items preserve ten unique source findings in immutable source order. EIC-W2 is corroborated by R2-W1 as a two-seat literature-positioning concern, below the four-seat CONSENSUS-3/4 threshold, with the EIC Major and R2 Minor severities transported separately. The other eight items are single-source findings. The DA supplied three Major rows and no Critical row.
dissenting_opinions: Methodology scored D3 pass while DA scored a repairable D3 block. Under the sprint contract, the DA block fires F2 through the any quantifier and yields Major Revision; it is not averaged with or softened by the methodology pass, while D3 does not satisfy F3's two-seat majority predicate.

The four non-DA cards credit the manuscript's finite/global scope discipline, while DA-M1 identifies residual primitive-Euler wording that exceeds the non-deduplicated correspondence-component domain. REV-07 adopts multiset-scoped wording as the minimum remedy; cross-instance canonicalization and recomputation remain an optional stronger evidence path requiring separate authorization.

Methodology and domain review accept the existing finite root certificates, while DA-M3 identifies the missing manuscript-level completeness argument. REV-09 requires self-contained auditability without changing the frozen finite result or implying a global primitive census.
